name: Sense Dissonace (Duergar)
body:
–

Benefit: Your psionic abilities help you tell if a person is under the psychic control of another, by sensing psionic dissonance around them. You gain a +2 trait bonus to Sense Motive for the “sense enchantment” and “hunch” functions.

Special: This trait my only be selected by Duergars.
